messages:
vikram (infra): Heads up — looks like a promo credit got applied to a GCP overage invoice instead of our Dedicated reserved commitment ledger. ~\\$11,800 landed on invoice GCP-987654 (project: redwood-dedicated-us-east1-overage). Can finance pls check and advise? :eyes:

emma (finance): Ugh. Can you paste the invoice line and the credit ID if you have it? I can pull the export but faster if you share the rows.

vikram (infra): Sure — grabbed from our billing export. Paste below:
```
invoice_id,project,charge_type,amount,credit_id
GCP-987654,redwood-dedicated-us-east1-overage,compute_overage,11800.00,CR-2026-07-01-42
GCP-987650,redwood-dedicated-commit,commitment_fee,50000.00,
```

billing-bot: Credit CR-2026-07-01-42: amount=11800.00 USD, type=promo, allocated=false, expires=2026-07-10T00:00:00Z, applied_to_invoice=GCP-987654.

talia (sre): Noted. This matches a surge we had last week where Dedicated autoscaling spilled into on-demand and generated overage. If the credit was promo for committed capacity it should have been applied to commitment invoices, not overage.

emma (finance): Thanks. I'll open a ticket with GCP billing to request reversal/reallocation. Two paths: 1) ask provider to reassign the credit on their side (preferred) or 2) we do an internal journal entry to move credit from overage to reserved-commit ledger. Which do we need for accounting?

matthew (platform): From product/accounting perspective we want the committed-usage credit consumed first against the commitment invoice to reduce our reserved liability. If provider refuses, do the journal entry but we need a note for auditors.

emma (finance): OK — starting provider dispute. Filing now and adding supporting docs. Ticket: GCP-TKT-2309123. ETA for initial response 48-72h. If they decline, I'll prepare a reversing JE and route through @matthew for sign-off.

vikram (infra): FYI the promo was from a channel partner offer tied to dedicated commits (contract ID: RC-2025-11). Credit metadata shows "scope: dedicated-commit" — weird that it applied to overage.

emma (finance): Good to know. I'll include the contract stub in the dispute. Also checking expiration: billing-bot says expires 2026-07-10. If dispute drags past that date, vendor might drop reallocation. We'll need contingency.

billing-bot: Note: credit CR-2026-07-01-42 has payment application history: applied_to=GCP-987654 on 1861123300. Origin event: partner-redwood-offer-v2.

talia (sre): Can infra avoid future spillover by tightening autoscale thresholds for Dedicated pools? We should reduce incident surface while finance sorts this.

vikram (infra): Will do a short-term throttle tonight (0215 UTC) and open a follow-up PR to change the burst policy thresholds.

emma (finance): Thanks. I'll update the thread when GCP responds. If anyone has additional invoice rows or more credits impacted, drop them here. :thumbsup:
